NRW will presumably respond formally; the final statement shapes how SI3's integration agenda is applied in practice. summary: On 19 June 2026 the Welsh Government opened consultation on the draft Environmental Principles and Integrating Environmental Protection Statement under the Environment (Principles, Governance and Biodiversity Targets) (Wales) Act 2026. The statement operationalises the four principles (prevention, precaution, rectification at source, polluter pays) that Welsh Ministers and NRW must apply in policy making. Consultation closes 11 September 2026.
title: Consultation opens on the Environmental Principles Statement that NRW must apply under the 2026 Act
